Fixture Regulation B on authorisation of declarants

Article 1
Application for authorisation
A person established in the customs territory may apply for the status of
authorised declarant. The application shall be submitted through the registry
and shall include the applicant's economic operator registration number.

Article 2
Criteria
The competent authority shall grant the status where the applicant has not
committed a serious infringement of customs legislation during the five years
preceding the application, and demonstrates financial and operational capacity
to fulfil the obligations under this instrument.

Article 3
Decision period
The competent authority shall take a decision within 120 calendar days of
receipt of a complete application. Where additional information is requested,
that period is suspended until the information is provided.

Article 4
Revocation
The status may be revoked where the holder no longer satisfies the criteria in
Article 2, or where the holder has failed to submit three consecutive
quarterly reports.

Article 5
Charges
No charge shall be levied for an application. A holder shall notify the
competent authority of any change to the information on which the decision was
based within 30 calendar days of the change.
